title: Custom export deletes the previous EPUB before the replacement is safely written
reasoning: When exporting a digest with the same name, the SAF target file is deleted before the new document is created and copied. If createDocument, openOutputStream, or the stream copy fails, the previous exported copy is already gone, leaving the user with neither the old nor the new file in the custom directory.
recommendation: Write the new export under a temporary unique display name first, verify the copy completes, then replace/delete the previous target. If SAF provider rename support is unavailable, avoid deleting the old target until after the new document exists and has been fully written.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There are no included EpubExporter tests, and the EPUB generator tests do not cover SAF overwrite failure behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an EpubExporter test with a fake ContentResolver/DocumentsProvider that reports an existing file, succeeds deleting it, then fails openOutputStream; assert the implementation does not delete the previous file before a successful replacement is available.
minimumFixScope: EpubExporter.copyFileToSafDirectory overwrite order and error handling.
